title: Hazard, Med Bay, Lab, and Vault Desk
summary: Documents midgame risk states for toxic routes, radiation exposure, mutation treatment, med bay recovery, bio labs, reactor ruins, and military vaults.
nextSteps: Read the hazard marker before crossing into a toxic or radiation route.
Check mutation status and med bay supplies before entering labs or vaults.
Recover data logs as route context, not as disposable loot text.
Use Lens and HoloMap together so lab and vault markers explain counterplay.
Return to base after severe exposure and treat the status before starting another route.

panels.title: Hazard Readout
panels.body: Toxicity, radiation, atmosphere, and weather copy should tell the player whether to enter, delay, or retreat.

panels.title: Medical State
panels.body: Mutation status, bandages, RadAway, stim packs, and med bay UI describe recovery before the next expedition.

panels.title: Lab and Vault State
panels.body: Bio labs, reactor ruins, and military vaults expose mission, scan, loot, and data-log context before combat or salvage.
